summary: Welcome/splash screen feature validated end-to-end on Expo web preview at 390x844. On '/', the welcome-screen and welcome-image render, then auto-redirect (no user interaction) to /home after ~1.8s where module-M1.A becomes visible. Home shows all 4 cards (M1.A, M1.B, Tita I, Tita II) plus menu-button. Menu opens with lang-english + menu-videos; menu-videos navigates to /videos (video-card-v1, video-card-v2 both present). Back from /videos and back from /m1a both return to /home; the welcome-screen never re-appears (router.replace correctly wiped it from history). Regression: module-M1.A -> generate-button -> card-affirmative shows 'I can see.' with the eyes emoji. Zero pageerrors. Only harmless web-only warnings observed (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, and Animated useNativeDriver fallback on web — the last one is expected because RCTAnimation is native-only; JS-driven fade/scale still runs correctly).
action_items: OPTIONAL: The useNativeDriver warning on the welcome splash is harmless on web (falls back to JS animation), but if you want a totally clean console on web, gate useNativeDriver behind Platform.OS !== 'web' in app/index.tsx (lines 24, 30). Native builds will still get the native driver.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx clean, minimal, and correct: router.replace('/home') ensures back navigation cannot land on the splash (verified in test). Timer cleanup via clearTimeout is present.
Ionicons 'flower' icon in home.tsx module-M1.B is dead code (emoji '🐝' overrides it) — same note as iteration_5; cosmetic only.
Static require of ../assets/images/tita-welcome.png confirmed at path assets/images/tita-welcome.png; asset present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome splash lives at app/index.tsx (testID welcome-screen, image welcome-image), auto-redirects via router.replace('/home') after 1800ms. Main menu moved to app/home.tsx. Back navigation from any child route lands on /home (verified). Only expected web-preview warnings are the useNativeDriver fallback (harmless) and pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations.
